caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) of two models, Transformer and MoHD, under different settings of shared sub-dimensions ratio. The x-axis is labeled "Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims" and has a linear scale with values ranging from 0/4 to 4/4, with tick labels at intervals of 1/4. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" and has a linear scale with values ranging from 10.0 to 12.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains two lines: one for Transformer, which is orange and dashed, and one for MoHD, which is blue and solid. The Transformer line remains steady at approximately 11.7 Eval PPL across all x-axis values. The MoHD line starts at approximately 11.0 Eval PPL at 0/4, decreases to around 10.3 Eval PPL at 3/4, and then increases to about 10.7 Eval PPL at 4/4.
